description: WNBA betting analysis backed by a model calibrated on 3,318 real games (2013-2026) and every 2026 DraftKings opening and closing line. Use for anything WNBA: spreads, totals, moneylines, 1H/1Q lines, team totals, player props, playoff series and Finals prices, futures/awards, injury impact (A'ja Wilson, Caitlin Clark, Napheesa Collier, Paige Bueckers...), back-to-backs, expansion teams (Valkyries, Tempo, Fire), the 2026 scoring surge, or "what's the play tonight" on a WNBA slate. Also use when someone applies NBA rules of thumb (home court, rest, star value) to the WNBA, or asks how WNBA markets differ — the numbers do not transfer.
